title: Key Indicators On Household Employment Income Among Resident Employed Households, Annual
population_definition: Data refer to resident employed households. A resident employed household refers to a household where the household reference person is a resident (i.e. Singapore citizen or permanent resident), and with at least one employed person. Household employment income refers to the sum of income received by employed members of the household from employment and business, excluding the income of live-in domestic workers. Monthly household employment income includes employer Central Provident Fund (CPF) contributions and one-twelfth of annual bonus. Data on household employment income refers to household employment income before accounting for Government transfers and taxes, unless stated otherwise.

title: Key Indicators On Household Market Income Among Resident Households, Annual
population_definition: Data refer to resident households.  A resident household refers to a household where the household reference person is a resident (i.e. Singapore citizen or permanent resident).  Household market income refers to income received by households from the market economy before any Government transfers and taxes.  It comprises income from employment (including one-twelfth of annual bonuses and employer CPF contributions) and non-employment sources including investments (such as interests from savings and/or CPF balances, dividends from investments), rental, contributions from other households (such as allowance from children to parents not staying in the same household, alimony), pensions, annuities, royalties and regular payouts from CPF and insurance (i.e. CPF ElderShield and CareShield Life).  This income concept aligns with international standards, which define income as regular monetary or in-kind receipts available for current consumption without diminishing net worth.  The dollar values are in nominal terms.  Data for the latest year are preliminary. More data and analyses on household income can be found in the paper 'Key Household Income Trends, 2025'.  The paper can be accessed via the following web-link: https://www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/households/household-income/related-information.
